source_mark.candidate_interpretation: Non-coordinate mark before a complete five-coordinate GFVVV group. This is a framing hypothesis, not a deletion of an observed ADFGVX letter.

frame_hypothesis.meaning: A boundary is the number of received coordinates before the proposed missing group, after excluding the source mark.

prefix_policy: Retain every baseline source reading and unknown square cell before the 76-character suffix. In particular keep WORT, RM, and unresolved reference fields unchanged.
